title: Service Fee Terms of the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
These terms set the service fees of the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service and how they are booked.

**§1 Tier for fees.** *Retired clause:* "Fees are debited from the prefund balance under the tier held on the day they are incurred." This clause is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis.

**§2 One fee per source.** A source entry incurs at most one fee of each fee type, and the platform fee is debited once per billing month. Whether a fee of that kind has already been booked against that source entry, or a platform fee for that billing month, is read from the service's ledger before the fee is booked.

**§3 Per-disbursement fees.** A payout's position in its month is its place among the service's payouts of that calendar month, in order of entry date and then of the day's sequence number. A payout whose position is within the tier's included disbursements per month carries no per-disbursement fee; beyond it a payout to an external debit card costs the tier's external debit card fee and one to a bank account the tier's same-day ACH fee, while a payout to a Paystride card costs the tier's Paystride card fee and still uses up a place in the allowance.

**§4 Monthly platform fee.** *Retired clause:* "On the fee debit business day of each month the previous month's monthly platform fee is debited, reduced under the Earned Wage Access bundle terms when that applies." This clause is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis.

**§5 Other fees.** A wire deposit costs the tier's wire deposit fee, a returned deposit the tier's returned-deposit fee, a returned payout the tier's return handling fee, and a recall request the tier's recall fee. *Retired clause:* "and a closure before the minimum term from enrollment the early closure fee" — this part of §5 is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis.

**§6 Booking.** Each fee points to the entry that incurred it. A fee that comes to zero is not debited, and a fee the balance cannot cover is debited when funds arrive.

## §3 in a table

| Position of the payout in its month | Destination | Per-disbursement fee |
|---|---|---|
| within the included allowance | any | none |
| beyond the allowance | external debit card | the tier's external debit card fee |
| beyond the allowance | bank account | the tier's same-day ACH fee |
| beyond the allowance | Paystride card | the tier's Paystride card fee |

A payout to a Paystride card counts toward the allowance in the same way as any other payout.

## Worked example (hypothetical tier figures)

Take a tier with an allowance of 40 payouts and an external debit card fee of 1.10. The 40th payout of the month, to an external debit card, carries no per-disbursement fee. The 41st, also to an external debit card, costs 1.10. Had the 40th payout gone to a Paystride card, it would still have taken the 40th place, and the 41st payout would still be beyond the allowance.
